mapper.select: SELECT C.AUTO_CONFIG_ID, C.EXTERNAL_API_ID, C.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, R.RULE_NAME, R.CURRENT_VERSION, R.ENABLED AS RULE_ENABLED, C.ENABLED, C.CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_AUTO_CONFIG C INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE R ON C.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = R.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID WHERE C.EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId} ORDER BY R.RULE_NAME, C.AUTO_CONFIG_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_AUTO_CONFIG ( EXTERNAL_API_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, ENABLED, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{externalApiId}, #{transformRuleId}, #{enabled}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT C.EXTERNAL_API_ID, C.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, V.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_AUTO_CONFIG C INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE R ON C.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = R.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION V ON V.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = R.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID AND V.VERSION_NO = R.CURRENT_VERSION WHERE C.EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId} AND C.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ENABLED = 'Y' ORDER BY C.AUTO_CONFIG_ID
